title: Campaign 2 dense integral platform feasibility
objective: Create a checked-in bench-only, implementation-faithful dense-integral library-route feasibility target and exact guard/failure/interrupt/browser/Windows receipt protocol without changing production sources

oracles: independent prime-field coefficient and derivative replay
exact public exception and transactional failure schedule

handoff.summary: Added a bench-only ordinary-Python dispatcher model plus a content-addressed Node/browser/Windows receipt runner. Linux x64 executed both reviewed workloads through the real FLINT kernel and exhausted every checked-false, ordinary-exception, native-KeyboardInterrupt, and cooperative-checkpoint schedule (2/39 native calls and 8/119 checkpoints), with no partial publication and exact retry. Real Chromium executed the explicit generic browser policy on both long workloads with no candidate effects. The runner digest-binds six frozen artifacts and distinguishes actual execution, exact-current source, frozen evidence, and promotion authority.
risks: This lane intentionally does not modify the production Polynomial.integral dispatcher; its candidateImplementedInProduction and promotionAuthority claims remain false.

The real Chromium run used authenticated Wasm release commit e46a92d588122d63b88078073242c33ac6678297; the receipt marks that artifact stale relative to this lane. Building a new release reached 276 kernels but sealing was blocked by the pre-existing stale hyperelliptic auto-receipt source bundle.
No Windows x64, Linux arm64, macOS arm64, Firefox, or WebKit execution occurred here. The Windows output is explicitly a portable command contract, not a receipt.
The input caps bound source size, block size, and call count, but do not establish a hard real-time latency bound for a direct synchronous embedding.

Checked native false restarts the untouched generic operation. Unexpected ordinary native exceptions propagate unchanged; KeyboardInterrupt is explicitly rethrown. Production review must preserve that distinction.
next_steps: Cherry-pick this lane commit into the integration lane and rerun the Node receipt with --require-exact-current --require-frozen-evidence.

At the production candidate epoch, adapt the reviewed dispatcher into public_structural.py without weakening the strict p <= 65537, length <= 100000, and length < 256*p guards or the complete singular preflight.
Build an exact-current browser-Wasm release after repairing the unrelated hyperelliptic receipt bundle, then execute Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit receipts.
Run the emitted Windows command on Windows x64 with the six digest-pinned frozen artifacts, and obtain Linux arm64/macOS arm64 receipts required by campaign policy.

Bind final platform receipts, worker-isolation or per-block latency authority, and the public production diff into the promotion dossier; do not treat this feasibility receipt itself as promotion authority.
